rationale: Sam brings hands-on experience in autonomous vehicle tooling and systems integration from Applied Intuition, while Arjun is building ML infrastructure and autonomous agent capabilities with Python, TypeScript, and JavaScript. They can exchange practical insights on autonomous systems architecture—Sam offering production perspective on AV development workflows, and Arjun bringing fresh approaches to ML infrastructure that could inform tooling design.
intro_message: Sam Morstein, meet Arjun Arora — Sam's experience shipping AV integration tools at Applied Intuition pairs well with Arjun's ML infrastructure and autonomous agents work; could be a good conversation on systems thinking.
